policy: Latest-per-sheet official CoastA marine polygons. Preserve every source coordinate. Subtract only marine CoastA; do not subtract LakeA, ReservoirA, PondA or WatrcrsA. 50k fallbacks are clipped to uncovered25k frames only. Select largest resulting mainland component; review detached-island and seam evidence before adoption.
